incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: latency.p99 exceeded threshold for service=redwood-inference-frontend (p99=4.6s, threshold=3.0s). alert_id=latency-p99-446789. Linked PagerDuty incident: https://pd.example/incidents/PDI-446789

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PDI-446789 created and notified escalation policy 'eng-oncall'. Pager on-call: Alice (5m window).

Alice (eng-oncall): acked. Looking now. Any obvious deploys?

Ben (sre): nothing in deploys 5m window. Checking autoscaler and KV cache metrics.

Sara (platform): I'm seeing a spike in request size distribution and a weird tail in long-running KV-reads. Dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/d/infra/latency?panel=p99

Alice (eng-oncall): p95 jumped from ~120ms to 850ms over last 10m. p99 ~4.5s. Error rate stable. Seems slow rather than errored. Could be kvcache thrash or a slow sidecar.

Ben (sre): running quick checks on sidecars. logs: ```kubectl -n inference logs -l app=sidecar -c sidecar | tail -n 50``` saw repeated timeouts to redis: "GET key timeout after 2s" and many `STALL` entries.

Sara (platform): redis cluster metrics show increased latency and connection churn on shard-3. Might be hot keying.

Alice (eng-oncall): Plan: 1) temporarily reduce routing to shard-3 by shifting 30% traffic to fallback ring. 2) if that reduces p99, we continue; else rollback recent kernel change. Anyone want to own the traffic shift?

Ben (sre): I can do the traffic shift. Doing `./ops/traffic-shift --service inference-frontend --from-shard shard-3 --percent 30 --dry-run` then apply.

Ben (sre): applied shift. Confirming... :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Sara (platform): Grafana shows immediate improvement on frontend tail for the requests that hit fallback ring. p99 down to ~2.9s for shifted traffic, overall p99 moving to 3.8s. Good sign.

Mika (product-sla): Heads up: customer-impact assessment — Dashboard shows top 5 customers in tail. Two customers (acme-corp, beta-inc) hit 5s+ response times for some queries. No errors but UX likely degraded. Sending heads-up to CSMs.

pagerduty-bot: PDI-446789 escalated to second-level after 8 minutes without resolution. Notifying Ben (sre-lead).

Alice (eng-oncall): Ben, do you see any autoscaler throttles? Could be node pressure causing KV proxy queueing.

Ben (sre): autoscaler is healthy, but GPU pool 2 shows high memory pressure and OOM events on some pods earlier. Those pods recovered, but sidecar backlog may have grown. Looking at node kubelet logs.

Alice (eng-oncall): Good call. If node pressure persists, let's spin an extra node in pool-2 as fallback. Ben, can you trigger a one-off scale? Command: ```gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize pool-2-group --size=+1```

Ben (sre): spinning +1 node now. ETA ~90s. :gear:

Sara (platform): Added a temporary increase to sidecar connection pool limits in non-prod earlier; curious if that change leaked to prod canary and caused imbalance. Investigating canary pipeline.

Alice (eng-oncall): Noted. If we don't see stable p99 under 3s in 15m, we should consider rolling traffic back to a previous model variant that avoids heavy KV reads. Sara, can you prepare the variant switch?

Sara (platform): Yep. Preparing a staged rollout to variant v2-safe. Will hold until we confirm.

Mika (product-sla): CSMs notified. Customers with degraded UX: acme-corp (account #1234), beta-inc (acct #5678). Estimated affected RPS ~120 (2% of global traffic). No financial impact reported yet.

pagerduty-bot: PDI-446789 acknowledged by Alice. Time to ack: 00:02:13.

Ben (sre): New node came up, kubelet logs show pods draining and scheduling happened. Sidecar timeouts reduced. p99 drifted to ~2.6s overall.

Alice (eng-oncall): Great. Observed tail improving. Keeping the temporary traffic shift and the extra node for next 30m while we root cause.

Sara (platform): Found that a config flag (`sidecar.prefetch=false`) defaulted to `true` in a canary rollout earlier this morning; that caused heavier sync load on redis leading to hot keys. Rolling that canary back now.

Ben (sre): Can confirm. After rollback, redis shard-3 connections normalized, connection churn down. p95/p99 trending toward baseline.

Mika (product-sla): Customer notifications updated: saying we're mitigating and monitoring; next update in 30m unless resolved.

Alice (eng-oncall): Update for handoff: I'll keep monitoring for 20m then handoff to Chris on next shift. Notes: traffic-shift 30% from shard-3, extra node in pool-2 added, canary flag rollback, watch redis shard-3. If p99 creeps back up, either remove shard-3 entirely or flip to v2-safe model variant.

Chris (next-oncall): I'll take over at 4467892100 (handoff time). Please DM any alerts that pop after handoff. Bridge: https://meet.example/bridge/446789

Alice (eng-oncall): handing off to Chris. Leaving channel but ping me if the rollback status changes. :thumbsup:

pagerduty-bot: Incident PDI-446789 status: monitoring. No new escalations.

incident-bot: Incident note added: "Temporary traffic shift and node scale mitigated p99 tail. Follow-up: investigate canary config propagation and KV hot-keying. Postmortem required if incident > 1hr."

Chris (next-oncall): acked and on-call accepted handoff. Will verify runbook steps and follow up in 30m.

Alice (eng-oncall): sign-off. Closing loop for now. :white_check_mark:
